 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Freiburg are looking to bounce back from consecutive defeats this afternoon, as they welcome Bundesliga leaders Bayern Munich to Europa-Park Stadion.
 Julian Schuster's side suffered a 2-1 defeat against Bayer Leverkusen last weekend, seeing their unbeaten start to the season come to an end, before they fell to a 3-0 loss against Monaco in the Conference League on Thursday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bayern on the other hand, arrive in Baden sitting one point ahead of their third-placed opponents after a 6-1 win against RB Leipzig last time out, alongside a 2-2 draw against Arsenal in midweek.
 However, Der Rekordmeister will be without head coach Vincent Kompany, who remains under medical care, with assistant Aaron Danks taking charge.
 With kick-off scheduled for 17:30 CET, both clubs have announced their starting lineups for the clash, and you can find all the details below.
 Confirmed SC Freiburg vs. Bayern Munich lineups
 Freiburg: Backhaus - Treu, Ginter, Lienhart, Makengo - Eggestein, Osterhage - Beste, Suzuki, Scherhant - Höler
 Bayern: Urbig - Stanisic, Upamecano, Tah, Brown - Bischof, Laimer - Olise, Karl, Gnabry - Kane (C)
